title: Tibetan glacier monthly SAT reconstruction with source-complete bounded inputs
summary: Produce two bounded Parlung monthly glacier SAT rasters from MODIS, terrain, reanalysis and station-source projection.
evaluation: Output-first raster delivery checks, then concealed C raster comparison and station-disjoint independent validation; references, support, thresholds and scoring logic are private.
referenceNotes: C comprises the author-published January and July 2019 SAT grids. Independent B contains observed station truth, not reconstructed truth. The separate author-method stacking reconstruction is only the B comparator, not C or B.

scoreSemantics.0.6: Expert-level quality (C tolerance AND B non-inferiority)
scoreSemantics.0.8: Beyond-expert (0.6 gates AND prespecified B improvement)
scoreSemantics.1.0: Stronger improvement (0.8 gates AND second independent axis or stronger frozen B evidence)

baseline_reconstruction.published_grid_component: reference/author_grid_201901.tif and author_grid_201907.tif remain published-product C checks
